caption: The drawing consists of two views of a wooden chest. The top half of the image shows the chest open, revealing its interior. The inside lid of the chest has a decorative pattern with two diamond shapes, each bordered in brown and gold, and a central rectangular area that is bordered in green and shaded in gray, possibly representing a mirror or inset. Below this, there are two horizontal drawers, each with two small round knobs, colored in a mix of brown and orange hues, set into a frame bordered in gold and shaded brown along the sides. The bottom portion of the open chest, which forms the inside of the front wall, is decorated with a pattern of diagonal lines in alternating light and dark brown, converging into a central diamond shape. The lower half of the drawing depicts the chest closed. The exterior front face displays a grid of small square compartments filled with alternating diagonal line patterns in various shades of brown and yellow, bordered by a solid brown frame. There is a central lock with a metallic appearance and two metal feet visible at the bottom corners of the chest. The drawing is made with colored pencil or watercolor, and the background is plain, off-white paper. Scale markings and small text are present at the bottom left.
title: Toy Trunk
